title: Exercises · Question 1
html:
Question: Optimizing Wheel Configuration for a Warehouse Robot

Scenario:

A logistics company is deploying an autonomous warehouse robot to transport goods across a large distribution center. The robot needs to navigate efficiently, avoiding obstacles while ensuring stability and maneuverability.

The company is considering three different wheeled locomotion systems:

  1. Differential Drive (Two independently driven wheels)
  2. Ackermann Steering (Car-like steering mechanism)
  3. Omnidirectional Drive (Four Swedish wheels for full maneuverability)

The warehouse environment consists of:

  • Straight aisles (2m wide)
  • Sharp 90-degree turns at intersections
  • Randomly placed obstacles (requiring path adjustments)
  • Maximum speed limit: 1.5 m/s

Task:

Write a Python program that simulates the robot’s navigation using different wheeled locomotion models. The program should:

  1. Model the movement behavior of each wheeled locomotion system.
  2. Calculate the total time taken for the robot to navigate a 10m x 10m warehouse section with one turn and one obstacle avoidance event.
  3. Compare the efficiency of each system based on time taken and path adjustments.

Hints:

  • Assume differential drive takes extra time during turns due to in-place rotation.
  • Ackermann steering requires a turning radius, meaning it cannot turn instantly.
  • Omnidirectional drive allows sideways movement, reducing turn time.
  • Use a simple time = distance / speed model but add penalties for turning and obstacle avoidance.
